video_title: Jalen Brunson and Coach Brown Hold First Media Availability of Training Camp 2026

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on Andre Miller's addition to the team
quotes.excerpt: he's not coming in to be Mitch, he's coming in to be himself.
quotes.quote: Obviously, Mitch was near and dear to all our hearts. I think the best part about the situation Andre is in, he's not coming in to be Mitch, he's coming in to be himself. We got to give him the confidence to go out there and be himself. This is a new team, this is a new journey, so everything for us is going to be new and we're going to attack it every day. We put everyone in the position to be successful and just give each other confidence and encouragement.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Brunson on the addition of Andre Miller to the Knicks roster: He is not coming in to be Mitch, he is coming in to be himself. We got to give him the confidence to go out there and be himself.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his physical condition and summer routine
quotes.excerpt: I didn't do my normal summer stuff and so it wasn't just my normal summer.
quotes.quote: I didn't do my normal summer stuff and so it wasn't just my normal summer. I don't want to say catch up. I feel good, but I also know that it wasn't just my normal summer. It was similar to when I broke my hand a couple of years ago, but I was shooting earlier than I was this time. I was in the cast longer than I was before when I broke my hand. Plus it was a little bit earlier. I think I got surgery right after it happened. I didn't get surgery until like three weeks later because I didn't know it was a necessity.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Brunson says his summer routine was not normal due to injury recovery but feels good heading into training camp. He noted he was in a cast longer this time compared to when he broke his hand a few years ago.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's offensive potential this season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we can do a lot more, do a lot different things.
quotes.quote: I feel like we can do a lot more, do a lot different things. I think we unlocked something last year during the playoffs in a time of need and it worked. So it's going to be fun to kind of integrate it from the beginning of the season too.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Brunson believes the Knicks can do a lot more offensively this season. He says they unlocked something during the playoffs last year and plan to integrate those concepts from the beginning of the season.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his expectations for the season
quotes.excerpt: it exceeded expectations, honestly. I've always been someone who prepared for the worst and played for the best.
quotes.quote: It exceeded expectations, honestly. I've always been someone who prepared for the worst and played for the best, but winning in New York is no joke. It was a really cool experience. I've had times where I had time to relax and I enjoyed that, I spent time getting away from everything. Most times was rehabbing, and once I was out of the cast and cleared, I had obligations I had to go through, so I did all that, but I feel good and I know where to go to get to my happy place and I know where to go where I need to decompress, so I'm good.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Brunson reflects on his experience winning in New York: Winning in New York is no joke. It was a really cool experience.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on Andre's physical attributes and veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: his feet are quicker than what you could imagine. He's really light on his feet.
quotes.quote: He's a veteran, he's been there, done that with a few different teams. He's big body, he's got great feet. It seems like his instincts are pretty good on both ends of the floor. The thing that stands out the most, and it's early, we're just getting started, but his feet are quicker than what you could imagine. He's really light on his feet, which is a good thing. Having a guy that size with length and athleticism that understands the league can be beneficial long-term for us.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown on Andre Miller: He is really light on his feet, which is a good thing. Having a guy that size with length and athleticism that understands the league can be beneficial long-term for us.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on the team's approach to the regular season
quotes.excerpt: the 82-game season is about trying to find your way.
quotes.quote: We're not playing at that level for 82 games. We played at a pretty high level and a lot of people when they talk about it, they talk about Game 4 and Game 6 in Atlanta and so on. That's not going to happen over 82 games. For me, the 82-game season is about trying to find your way. There's a lot that will carry over for this year. We'll also experiment with some new things here and there, but the stuff that we had in the playoffs may not work during the regular season and so we have to be ready to evolve or pivot as the year goes along.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown says the Knicks will experiment with new things this season and warns that what worked in the playoffs may not work over an 82-game regular season. We have to be ready to evolve or pivot as the year goes along.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on integrating players and team versatility
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know if OG could be as effective as he was in the pick-and-roll game.
quotes.quote: Obviously, playing with Cat a little bit more than we did. Being with this group for a year now, you get a better feel of what players can do what. I didn't know if OG could be as effective as he was in the pick-and-roll game. Same with Mikhail. To try to continue to find ways to get those guys involved at the top of the floor is something that will take a look at. We have great cutters that have tremendous size. We'll continue to mix that in. And we all know that Cat is a really good facilitator at the elbow. Maybe Andre is too, I don't know. Maybe we move OG to the five a little bit more than what we did last year. There are a lot of different ways we can go with the team on both ends of the floor. The biggest thing is knowing that nothing's set in stone.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown is considering moving OG Anunoby to the five more often this season. He noted that nothing is set in stone as the team looks for ways to utilize their versatility and playmaking at the elbow.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on conditioning and team expectations
quotes.excerpt: I didn't put a ton of pressure on them to get back in the gym in August.
quotes.quote: I didn't put a ton of pressure on them to get back in the gym in August. We put a little bit more pressure on our younger guys and our older guys. We wanted everybody to start coming back after Labor Day and for the most part, most of the guys did. But again, if they didn't and they needed more time, I didn't pressure them because we'll have our fair share of practices to get back into it. After today's practice, and it's early, all the guys look like they're in pretty good shape, especially for a short summer. We have a conditioning test that we did last year and this year that the guys have to pass to get into camp and they all passed it.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown says the Knicks players are in good shape for the start of camp. He confirmed that every player on the roster passed the team conditioning test.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on his relationship with James Wiseman
quotes.excerpt: he's a fantastic human being, fantastic young man.
quotes.quote: We didn't stay in touch where we call each other or anything like that, but whenever we saw each other, we obviously acknowledged one another. He's a fantastic human being, fantastic young man. It was one of the things where I'm sure he wanted the best for me and I definitely wanted the best for him. It's good to see him in the gym and when you're that long and that athletic with skill, there's a place for you in this league and sometimes it takes the right moment, the right team, the right situation to be able to fit some place and grow and we have a lot of great guys in camp that have the potential of impacting us in a lot of different ways throughout the course of the year and he's definitely one of the many guys that we have that we're excited about.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown on James Wiseman: When you are that long and that athletic with skill, there is a place for you in this league. Sometimes it takes the right moment, the right team, the right situation to be able to fit some place and grow.

quotes.speaker: Coach Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Brown on the team's resilience and player development
quotes.excerpt: we won in 22, nobody did anything extra special. We had a young player and Jordan Poole step up.
quotes.quote: I experienced it when I was in Golden State. We won in 17 and 18. We lost Kevin Durant after that and it was funny because the outside world was like, oh my gosh, the world's going to crash now because KD is that special of a player. When we won in 22, nobody did anything extra special. We had a young player and Jordan Poole step up. We had Andrew Wiggins probably have his best year since being drafted, come in and step up. And a guy that not a lot of people remember, Otto Porter, stepped up. So everybody else just did a little bit more to try to balance out what we had missing from KD. It's no different here. We're not expecting Andre to come in and be Mitch or impact the game in a lot of different ways that Mitch did. Hey, just be yourself, but everybody else has to step up and box out a little bit harder and come across earlier to help stop the penetration sooner.
quotes.social_post: Coach Brown on replacing production: We are not expecting Andre to come in and be Mitch. Everybody else has to step up and box out a little bit harder and come across earlier to help stop the penetration sooner.
